name: wasi-crm-server
description: Backend for the Wasi CRM tech-provider platform — auth, tenant data, Meta Embedded Signup + WhatsApp Cloud API messaging, Razorpay billing, admin panel API.

scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/guard-db.js && dotenv -e .env -- node-pg-migrate up -m src/db/migrations --envPath .env
scripts.db:migrate:down: node scripts/guard-db.js && dotenv -e .env -- node-pg-migrate down -m src/db/migrations --envPath .env
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate:down -- 0 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
